notes.title: Bowl Bound Giveaway!
notes.content:
Opium Pulses and Grey Dog Software team up to offer it's fans 5 copies of the game!

Here is the announcement: 

http://steamcommunity.com/groups/OpiumPulsesGiveaways#announcements/detail/47641151596433630

And a link to the Giveaway: https://steamcompanion.com/gifts/KBP9/bowl-bound-college-football/

We hope you are enjoying this game! As always please let us know on the forums if you ever need any assistance with this game or have feedback on it. 

Jason Carver
Community Support at Encore Software
